title: 三星55万亿回报：为何压住股价，市场等1月底
speaker: Sanjeev Rana

segments.en: Why is the market reaction so bad this morning?
segments.zh: 为什么今早市场反应这么差？

segments.en: Good morning, and thanks for having me on your program.
segments.zh: 早上好，感谢邀请我参加节目。

segments.en: Actually, the market had expected another round of share buybacks or additional dividend announcements beyond what has already been announced.
segments.zh: 实际上，市场原本预期会有新一轮权益资产回购或额外分红公告，超出已宣布的范围。

segments.en: However, the company differed announcement until late January next year, which appears to be driving shares lower, unlike high-necks,
segments.zh: 然而，公司将公告推迟到明年1月底，这似乎压低了股价，不像海力士那样，

segments.en: which announced, you know, meaningful buyback and dividends.
segments.zh: 海力士宣布了有意义的回购和分红。

segments.en: Samsung had nothing new to add to beyond what it has already announced.
segments.zh: 三星除了已宣布的内容外，没有新东西可补充。

segments.en: That said, the company is still indicating 55 to 75 filling one additional shareholder returns for this year.
segments.zh: 尽管如此，公司仍表示今年将额外返还55%至75%的股东回报。

segments.en: We detailed to be announced in late January. So a meaningful catalyst still remains in my view.
segments.zh: 我们预计将在1月底公布细节。因此，在我看来，仍有重要的催化剂。

segments.en: What about for the miss on the chip business, Sanjeev? Should we be worried about that?
segments.zh: Sanjeev，芯片业务不及预期呢？我们应该担心吗？

segments.en: I don't think the miss was that significant.
segments.zh: 我认为不及预期的程度并不那么显著。

segments.en: It was a minor miss and most likely related to Korean one strength.
segments.zh: 这是一个小幅未达预期，很可能与韩元走强有关。

segments.en: Actually, if you look at the DMN and ASPs, those were in line with expectations.
segments.zh: 实际上，如果你看DMN和平均售价，这些都与预期相符。

segments.en: So maybe some minor effects related issues were there.
segments.zh: 所以可能存在一些与小幅影响相关的问题。

segments.en: But overall, I wouldn't call it a big miss. And overall, the company's earnings outlook remains pretty good.
segments.zh: 但总体而言，我不会称之为大幅未达预期。而且总体来看，公司的盈利前景仍然相当不错。

segments.en: We expect tight memory supply to persist for the next three to five years.
segments.zh: 我们预计内存供应紧张将持续未来三到五年。

segments.en: Lightly in a through 2030 in our view.
segments.zh: 在我们看来，这一趋势可能延续到2030年。
